title: translate a reviewed knowledge article with controlled terminology
input: The content application submits permitted source text and target language with applicable terminology configuration.
action: Cloud Translation generates the supported translation using its selected model or glossary settings. The application preserves source context and requires review where incorrect wording could materially affect the reader.
output: The editor corrects terminology and publishes the accepted translated article.
check: Test language selection, glossary terms, formatting and sensitive-text handling before sharing the translation.

title: coordinate a supported infrastructure maintenance event
input: The infrastructure owner selects the supported maintenance scope and workload availability requirements.
action: Unified Maintenance presents or coordinates supported maintenance information and controls under its configured resource coverage. Actual host or resource maintenance follows the chosen service's behavior; the owner plans application continuity explicitly.
output: The operations team schedules the allowed maintenance or workload evacuation and informs affected owners.
check: Check supported controls, actual event timing, restart behavior and application readiness after maintenance.

title: move a supported vSphere application into a managed private cloud
input: The virtualization owner inventories VMs, network segments, licensing and application dependencies.
action: VMware Engine provides the supported VMware private-cloud infrastructure. VMware migration tools transfer VM state; application owners validate target storage, networking and data consistency before cutover.
output: The target VM serves the application over the approved private network and protected database path.
check: Test licensing, VM compatibility, final synchronization, DNS changes and rollback before retiring source hosts.

title: annotate a permitted video for searchable scene metadata
input: The media application submits an authorized video and selects the supported annotation features.
action: Video Intelligence analyzes the video for selected supported insights such as labels, shot changes or text. Returned timestamps and annotations require validation; the application decides which metadata belongs in its catalog.
output: The editor reviews relevant annotations and links accepted metadata to the corresponding playback time.
check: Check timing alignment, recognition quality, sensitive content and original-video access before publication.

title: construct a personalized advertising session for video playback
input: The player requests an authorized playback session with the permitted ad context.
action: Video Stitcher combines supported content and ad-decision inputs into the configured playback session. The ad decision server chooses eligible ads; stitching creates the session's playback response according to its configuration.
output: The player follows the returned manifest and the application handles permitted playback reporting.
check: Test ad-server failure, missing ads, manifest continuity and viewer-data minimization before the event.

title: extract readable text from an approved image
input: The document application submits an authorized image and selects the supported OCR feature.
action: Vision API analyzes the image and returns detected text with available structure or location information. The application validates OCR before using identifiers or amounts in a business transaction.
output: The reviewer corrects uncertain text and accepts the relevant document fields.
check: Test rotation, low resolution, language, incorrect amounts and access to extracted personal information.

title: find catalog products resembling an authorized query image
input: The storefront supplies a permitted product photo and selects the configured searchable product set.
action: Product Search compares the query image with the supported indexed reference products and returns ranked matches. Catalog indexing and product-set filters bound the candidates; the commerce backend validates current availability.
output: The customer sees accepted product matches and purchases through the separate authorized checkout path.
check: Check reference-image quality, index freshness, category relevance and stale inventory before displaying results.

title: check a submitted URL before allowing the application to use it
input: The application validates the URL syntax and submits the permitted URL to its supported threat-check workflow.
action: Web Risk checks the URL using the selected supported lookup or list-based mechanism and returns threat evidence. The application applies its own block or review policy; a clean result does not prove every destination is safe.
output: The backend rejects flagged destinations and handles allowed navigation or fetches through its separate SSRF controls.
check: Test flagged URLs, timeouts, list freshness and internal-address denial before enabling automatic URL use.

title: assess a supported enterprise workload's configuration
input: The operations owner selects the supported workload type and resources requiring best-practice evaluation.
action: Workload Manager evaluates supported workload configuration against its available rules and evidence. Findings guide the owner toward relevant configuration changes; evaluation does not modify application data or guarantee availability.
output: The resource owner validates a finding and applies the approved infrastructure or application configuration repair.
check: Reevaluate the affected rule and run an actual application acceptance test before closing the issue.

title: deploy a reviewed resource using an authenticated command
input: The operator selects the intended account, project and explicit CLI command parameters.
action: gcloud translates the supported command into Google Cloud API requests using configured credentials. IAM and resource APIs enforce permissions; the CLI is a management client rather than the application's data-processing runtime.
output: The operator inspects the command result and verifies the created or changed resource.
check: Check account and project context, denied operations, idempotent command behavior and actual resource readiness.
